question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget ship now as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin, or wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway activity contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The feature request is coherent, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent status is a product/API sequencing choice rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate implementation while requiring its proof, merge blockers, and source-of-truth questions to clear before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles the richer Gateway activity and attention model, then implement the widget against that API.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing only if this issue's unique agent-status requirements are explicitly preserved there.

recommendation.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate implementation while requiring its proof, merge blockers, and source-of-truth questions to clear before closing this issue.
